notes.title: For Evelyn 1.3.0 Update!
notes.notes:
​For Evelyn has been updated to 1.3.0.

Changelog:


 Added more than 340 new lines of dialogue for NPCs
 Added some more lore pieces
 Removed some unnecessary things
 Fixed some minor bugs

notes.title: For Evelyn 1.2.0 Update!
notes.notes:
​For Evelyn has been updated to 1.2.0 with multiple big changes.

Changelog:


 Updated Water Shaders​
 Battle enhancments, new skills, more interactive and polished combat.
 More animations and sprite polish.
 New playable areas.
 Added fast travel points to bigger areas.
 Follower dialogue regarding current play area.
 Added Museum of Troutbeck.
 General bug fixes.

notes.title: For Evelyn - Major NPC & Music Update
notes.notes:
This is the first big update to For Evelyn. The changelog is as follows:


Added several new music tracks to the game.
Modified where some music plays.
Added about 80 new NPCs to the world, all with stuff to say.
New Quests!
New lore, told by some of the new NPCs.
Adjusted QTE timings and difficulty.
Revoiced some voiced dialogue with errors in grammar.
Rewrote some important dialogue.
Added some animations.
Added walking routes to some NPCs
Added more dialogue to certain NPCs.
Fixed some errors in the Objective menu.
Added a potion store to Chapter 3.
Added choices to certain quests.
Added more opportunities to gain skillpoints.
Rebalanced some monetary rewards.
Readjusted the lighting in some scenes.
Fixed some menus not scaling correctly on different resolutions.
Various general bug fixes.
Plus some other things that I may have forgotten...


This update is made hoping to enhance the playing experience for some of you players. There will be more updates in the coming months. Happy gaming!

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.notes: 1.0.2 Update available with some more bug fixes and slightly adjusted combat stats.

notes.title: For Evelyn 1.0.1 Update
notes.notes: For Evelyn has been updated to 1.0.1 with bug fixes, passability corrections, and grammar fixes, and as a bonus recreated one of the side quests in the first chapter.

notes.title: For Evelyn Demo updated with latest changes
notes.notes:
For Evelyn Demo updated with latest changes like:

- New footstep sounds, depending on what kind of surface you're walking on!

- Completely redone tutorial!

- New opportunities to gain (or lose) skillpoints!

- General fixes and tweaks

notes.title: Small update for Steam Game Festival
notes.notes: Steam Game Festival is upon us! I created a small update, fixing some minor issues, and rehauled a scene near the end of the game and added skill requirements for the choices in that scene.
